headline: Encore Semi lists a Quad ADC digital-verification role with AI-assisted log analysis and debug
fact: On October 5, Encore Semi listed a verification role for the digital subsystem of Quad ADC products, including DSP blocks and digital paths operating between 250 MHz and 1 GHz. The posting assigns regression-environment development and testbench execution using Cadence Xcelium, and requests experience using AI tools to analyze data and logs and accelerate debugging. It concerns digital verification within a mixed-signal product; the description does not claim RNM model generation or AMS co-simulation.

sources.title: Encore Semi: High-speed mixed-signal verification role — employer LinkedIn posting
sources.summary: Employer posting checked October 5, 2026; first publication is not established, so the Event records this observation date. Duties concern Quad ADC digital regressions and DSP paths; AI-assisted data/log analysis is a requested skill.
